WITH filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
),
pre_agg_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        i_category, 
        i_class, 
        i_brand, 
        i_product_name, 
        d_year, 
        d_qoy, 
        d_moy, 
        s_store_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_date ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, s_store_id
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        i_category, 
        i_class, 
        i_brand, 
        i_product_name, 
        d_year, 
        d_qoy, 
        d_moy, 
        s_store_id,
        sumsales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM pre_agg_sales
)
SELECT * 
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE rk <= 100
ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100
